verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (402 touches) vs 42% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0476).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0065 (t=0.59) vs placebo 0.0094 (t=1.04). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
